do_not_assume: Do not assume the FALSIFIED conclusion generalizes to full-DOM — truncated-first-20 is a non-representative slice (7 tasks, 1 site, cart n=1, 3 definitions)
Do not assume the per-iteration recipe is universally canonical beyond this experiment's scope — the justification is principled but not empirically validated on non-truncated data
Do not assume the density metric is entirely useless — it means ordering-based discrimination is definition-sensitive, not that density values themselves are uninformative
Do not assume recipe choice is a nuisance parameter — it is a MATERIAL determinant of the scientific conclusion (flips C2 direction), not an implementation detail
Do not assume the observed agreement metric (0.333 from 3 definitions) is directly comparable to parent's 0.3 (from 5 definitions) — they are different metrics on different definition sets

Do not assume C-MEAS-VALID status changed from this experiment — it remains EXPERIMENTAL; this experiment scoped a finding within the density metric sub-problem, not the broader measurement validity claim
